description:
Ramen-Aid makes ramen better.

After years of formula development and hundreds of bowls of ramen, the team at Ramen-Aid is proud to announce the release of our first two products that will revolutionize how people will consume ramen.

We’ve developed a custom blend of vitamins and minerals to enhance your ramen soup experience. Working with our food scientist, we’ve created a formula that pairs seamlessly with your favorite ramen broth. At its core, each version of Ramen-Aid contains five key electrolytes, which work together with the sodium in your ramen to support hydration. But we didn’t stop there—we added an extra boost to each version to enhance your ramen and overall well-being.

Our first two products are now available, and we’re beyond excited to share them with you, your friends, and family! We’ve included a box of each to experience the difference for yourself.

Immunity Support
This version contains essential vitamins and minerals, including Vitamin C (300mg), D, B-complex, Manganese, and Zinc, to help support your immune system. Whether recovering from a long night out or feeling under the weather, this blend gives your body a much-needed boost. Our %DV (daily value) of each vitamin and mineral is comparable to—if not higher than—many leading immune-support products on the market.

Energy Boost with Caffeine
For those needing an extra kick, this version contains 80mg of caffeine—approximately the same as a cup of coffee. We maintained a moderate caffeine level so that even those who are sensitive to it can enjoy without feeling overwhelmed. It’s the perfect way to wake up both your ramen and you!

Why Ramen-Aid?

You might be wondering: Why use Ramen-Aid instead of other supplement powders like Emergen-C or Liquid IV? Here are a few key reasons:

  • No unnecessary fillers – Unlike other products, we don’t need to overload our formula with sugar or artificial sweeteners to mask the taste. Our blend works naturally with the flavors of your ramen broth.
  • Better synergy with food – Instead of drinking a separate supplement loaded with extra salt and sugar, you can enjoy the benefits of Ramen-Aid while eating something you already love.
  • A more enjoyable experience – Let’s be honest, ramen is way more satisfying than chugging a sugary electrolyte drink!

Whatever’s ailing you, we’re here to help. If our first two products don’t fit your needs, stay tuned – we’re already developing additional versions based on customer feedback.

We truly hope you enjoy Ramen-Aid and that it becomes a part of your ramen routine. Check out our website (Ramen-Aid.com) to learn more, and don’t forget to follow us on Instagram (ramenaid) and TikTok! If you love our product, please share our link with your friends and family.

Affiliate Program: Are you interested in our affiliate program? Our website provides all the details. It’s a unique opportunity to spread the word while earning commissions.
